item_name: McNett Tactical OP Drops Cleaning System .25 OZ
item_short_desc: McNett Tactical OP Drops offer superior anti-fog protection and lens cleaning system to improve optical performances.
description: McNett Tactical OP Drops offer superior anti-fog protection and lens cleaning system to improve optical performances. These lens cleaning drops can be used on sunglasses, goggles, scopes, and much more! This lens cleaning system comes with a micronet microfiber cleaning cloth to aid in the lens cleaning process. Never lose the alcohol-free lens drops with a lint-free carry pouch that can be attached to the OP drop cap. McNett Tactical’s lens cleaning kit provides a .25 oz bottle of the lens cleaning solution.
